title: MemEmo: Evaluating Emotion in Memory Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.20733v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Memory systems address the challenge of context loss in Large Language Models during prolonged interactions. However, as an essential tool for warm companionship and personalized services, the effectiveness of memory systems in processing affective information remains underexamined. To bridge this gap, we propose an emotion-enhanced memory evaluation benchmark to assess the performance of mainstream and state-of-the-art memory systems in integrating and harnessing emotional information. translated_title: MemEmo：评估记忆系统中的情感
translated_abstract: 记忆系统旨在解决大语言模型在长时间交互过程中上下文丢失的挑战。然而，作为一种提供温暖陪伴和个性化服务的重要工具，记忆系统在处理情感信息方面的有效性仍未得到充分研究。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一个情感增强的记忆评估基准，以评估主流和最先进的记忆系统在整合与利用情感信息方面的性能。首先，我们设计了一个名为MemEmo的基准，从四个维度评估记忆系统的情感推理与追踪能力：情感信息提取、情感记忆更新、情感记忆问答和情感冲突检测。其次，我们构建了类人记忆情感数据集，为深入审视记忆系统提供实证基础。
tldr: 提出了情感增强记忆评估基准MemEmo及HLME数据集，从情感信息提取、情感记忆更新、情感记忆问答和情感冲突检测四个维度评估记忆系统处理情感信息的能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes MemEmo, an emotion-enhanced memory evaluation benchmark with the HLME dataset, to assess memory systems' affective reasoning and tracking capabilities across four dimensions: emotional information extraction, emotional memory updating, emotional memory question-answering, and emotional conflict detection.
